statements.text: When TSMC trades about 2 % below its all-time high inside a sideways phase on falling volume, the price rose in 85 % of 13 independent cases within 3 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, TSMC came back every time: in all 7 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 24 months at most.
